sections.title: 六、看图读句子，选择与其意思相对应的图片
sections.instruction: 看图读句子，将句子的标号填写到与其意思相对应的图片下面的括号内（其中有一个句子为多余选项）。
wordbank: I put my keys on the table this morning, but they're not there now.
He played football with his brother and they were happy.
Her favourite book is Five Thousand Years of Chinese Nation.
I often play basketball with my friends after school.
In the museum, he saw an icebox from more than 2000 years ago.
The school was small and old in the past. Now it's nice and big.

questions.prompt: [图片：学校过去和现在的对比图，左侧标注 Past 显示一间矮小简陋的旧平房，右侧标注 Now 显示一栋现代化高大多层教学楼]
questions.answer: The school was small and old in the past. Now it's nice and big.
questions.translation: 这所学校过去又小又旧。现在它既漂亮又大。
questions.explanation: 图片展示了学校过去（Past）与现在（Now）的对比，与选项 F 完全对应。

questions.prompt: [图片：一个人翻找抽屉或书桌，表情惊讶疑惑，旁边有一张桌子]
questions.answer: I put my keys on the table this morning, but they're not there now.
questions.translation: 我今天早上把钥匙放在桌子上了，但现在它们不在那里了。
questions.explanation: 图片中人物在寻找找不到的物品，对应选项 A 中钥匙不在桌上的语境。

questions.prompt: [图片：两个男孩在球场上开心地踢足球]
questions.answer: He played football with his brother and they were happy.
questions.translation: 他和他的弟弟一起踢足球，他们很开心。
questions.explanation: 图片内容为两个男孩踢足球（played football），对应选项 B。

questions.prompt: [图片：博物馆展台上陈列的一件古老华丽的青铜冰鉴/古代容器]
questions.answer: In the museum, he saw an icebox from more than 2000 years ago.
questions.translation: 在博物馆里，他看到了一个两千多年前的古代冰鉴（冰箱）。
questions.explanation: 图片展示博物馆展台里的古代文物容器（古代冰鉴/青铜器），对应选项 E。

questions.prompt: [图片：一个小女孩坐着专心阅读一本大开本的图书]
questions.answer: Her favourite book is Five Thousand Years of Chinese Nation.
questions.translation: 她最喜欢的书是《中华上下五千年》。
questions.explanation: 图片为一个女孩在阅读厚书，对应关于最喜爱的书的描述选项 C。

sections.title: 七、读句子，找出与其含义相符的单词
sections.instruction: 读句子，找出与其含义相符的单词，将相应的标号填写在括号内。

questions.prompt: It is the second month of a year.
questions.translation: 它是一年当中的第二个月份。
questions.explanation: February（二月）是一年中的第二个月。

questions.prompt: It means being happy and wanting to have fun.
questions.translation: 它意味着开心且想要找乐趣/爱玩的。
questions.explanation: playful 意为“爱玩耍的、嬉戏的”，与 prompt 含义一致。

questions.prompt: It is the name of a book, painting, play, etc.
questions.translation: 它是书籍、画作、戏剧等的名称/标题。
questions.explanation: title 意为“标题、作品名称”，与句意相符。

questions.prompt: This means giving someone money for something you buy.
questions.translation: 这表示为你买的东西给某人钱。
questions.explanation: pay 意为“支付、付钱”，符合定义描述。

questions.prompt: You use it to show how far back in the past something happened.
questions.translation: 你用它来表示某事发生在过去的多久之前。
questions.explanation: ago 意为“……以前”，用于表达距离现在多久之前的过去时间。

sections.title: 八、读对话，选择最佳选项补全对话
sections.instruction: 读对话，选择最佳选项，将对话补充完整。

dialogue.speaker: Sophia
dialogue.text: Hey, Max! I just read a story about Pang Zhongwang.

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: I know him. He is a student at Tsinghua University(清华大学). [1]

dialogue.speaker: Sophia
dialogue.text: It says he grew up in a very poor family. When he was young, his mum was ill. [2]

dialogue.speaker: Sophia
dialogue.text: He didn't give up. He picked up rubbish to make money and looked after his mum. [4]

dialogue.speaker: Sophia
dialogue.text: Yes. And in the end, he got into one of the best universities in China.

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.text: [5] Many young people can learn from him.

options: And his dad couldn't talk well.
What did he do about these problems?
He studied very hard at the same time.
I think Pang Zhongwang is a hero.

questions.translation: 故事里说了什么？
questions.explanation: 下文 Sophia 回答“It says he grew up in a very poor family...”，可知此空提问故事内容。

questions.answer: And his dad couldn't talk well.
questions.translation: 而且他的爸爸也不能正常说话。
questions.explanation: 承接前文讲述家庭贫困和母亲生病的艰难情况，继续补充家庭困难。

questions.answer: What did he do about these problems?
questions.translation: 面对这些困难他是怎么做的？
questions.explanation: 后文回答“He didn't give up. He picked up rubbish...”，说明此空提问他面对困难的应对做法。

questions.answer: He studied very hard at the same time.
questions.translation: 与此同时他学习非常刻苦。
questions.explanation: 说明他在捡垃圾挣钱照顾母亲的同时还非常刻苦学习，契合后文考上清华大学。

questions.answer: I think Pang Zhongwang is a hero.
questions.translation: 我认为庞众望是一位英雄。
questions.explanation: 总结评价庞众望的事迹，并引出后句“Many young people can learn from him.”。

sections.title: 九、阅读短文，选择恰当的单词
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容，选择恰当的单词，将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage: I am in the Go-Green Club(俱乐部). Last week, we had a fund-raiser (筹款活动) at school. We [1] with a recycling competition. People brought their used phones and [2] clothes. A boy brought the most things and won a T-shirt. Then we did a play called "Don't Waste It, Reuse It!" People in the play [3] all club members, and I was one of them. The play tickets were ¥15 each. We also sold a lot of delicious healthy snacks. We donated (捐献) all the [4] to the town's recycling centre. It was a lot of fun, [5] we protected the environment, too.

questions.translation: 我们以一场回收比赛作为开始。
questions.explanation: Last week 提示全文使用一般过去时，动词应选用过去式 started。

questions.translation: 人们带来了他们用过的手机和旧衣服。
questions.explanation: used phones 与 old clothes 并列，符合环保回收旧物的语境。

questions.translation: 话剧中的演员全都是俱乐部成员。
questions.explanation: 主语 People in the play 为复数名词，过去时系动词使用 were。

questions.translation: 我们把所有的钱都捐给了镇上的回收中心。
questions.explanation: 前文提到售卖门票和零食，活动是 fund-raiser（筹款活动），因此捐出的是筹集到的款项 money。

questions.translation: 这非常有趣，并且我们也保护了环境。
questions.explanation: 前后分句为递进顺承关系，且句末有 too，应使用连词 and 连接。

sections.title: 十、读配图短文，选择恰当的单词
sections.instruction: 读配图短文，从词库中选择恰当的单词填入括号内。

questions.prompt: John and Robert are brothers. Robert has a disease. He cannot walk or run. He feels ______ . He wants to go out and play with other kids.
questions.translation: 约翰和罗伯特是兄弟。罗伯特生病了，他无法走路或奔跑。他感到孤独。他想出去和其他孩子一起玩。
questions.explanation: 不能走跑、渴望和别人玩，表现出的心情是 lonely（孤独难过）。

questions.prompt: John loves his brother. He wants to ______ Robert happy. One day, he has a good idea. He finds a bike trailer(拖车).
questions.translation: 约翰爱他的弟弟。他想让罗伯特开心。有一天，他有了一个好主意。他找来了一辆自行车拖车。
questions.explanation: make sb + adj. 意为“使某人……”，make Robert happy 意为“让罗伯特开心”。

questions.prompt: John puts Robert in the trailer. They go out ______ . Robert sees trees and birds. He smiles and feels happy.
questions.translation: 约翰把罗伯特放进拖车里。他们一起出门。罗伯特看到了树和小鸟。他微笑并感到快乐。
questions.explanation: 兄弟俩一起出门，使用副词 together（一起）。

questions.prompt: The brothers join in a bike race. Other kids run fast. Robert says, "We are slow!" But John says, "Don't ______ , Robert! We are together."
questions.translation: 兄弟俩参加了一场自行车比赛。其他孩子骑得很快。罗伯特说：“我们太慢了！”但约翰说：“别担心，罗伯特！我们在一起。”
questions.explanation: Don't worry 意为“别担心”，是常见的安慰用语。

questions.prompt: John is tired, ______ he says, "I want to keep going." Robert says, "I'm right behind you."
questions.translation: 约翰累了，但他仍说：“我想坚持下去。”罗伯特说：“我一直在你身后。”
questions.explanation: 累了（tired）与坚持骑（keep going）之间存在转折关系，使用连词 but。

questions.prompt: At last, they finish the race. People clap. Robert says, "John, you are the ______ brother! I love you!"
questions.translation: 最后，他们完成了比赛。人们鼓掌欢呼。罗伯特说：“约翰，你是最棒的哥哥！我爱你！”
questions.explanation: the 后面接最高级 best，the best brother 意为“最好的哥哥”。

sections.title: 十一、读图书封面和封底，判断正误
sections.instruction: Ken正在阅读一本有关丝绸之路(The Silk Road)的书。读这本书的封面和封底，判断句子是否与其内容一致，一致的用“T”表示，不一致的用“F”表示。
sections.passage:
[FRONT COVER]
The Silk Road
Written by David Wang
Pictures by Mark Yang

[BACK COVER]
Are you ready for an adventure?
Let's travel the Ancient Silk Road! You will cross the deserts, climb the mountains, and visit the busy markets of thousands of years ago.
In this book, you will find out:
- why the Silk Road was important
- what people bought and sold
- how travellers got ready for the journey

questions.prompt: The title of the book is "The Silk Road".
questions.translation: 这本书的书名是《丝绸之路》。
questions.explanation: 封面正中央大字明确标有书名“The Silk Road”。

questions.prompt: Mark Yang wrote the book.
questions.translation: 马克·杨写了这本书。
questions.explanation: 封面显示“Written by David Wang”（大卫·王撰写），“Pictures by Mark Yang”（马克·杨绘制配图）。

questions.prompt: You can read about deserts, mountains and busy markets in this book.
questions.translation: 你可以在这本书中读到关于沙漠、山脉和繁华市场的内容。
questions.explanation: 封底提到“You will cross the deserts, climb the mountains, and visit the busy markets...”。

questions.prompt: This book tells you what to buy on the Silk Road today.
questions.translation: 这本书告诉你如今在丝绸之路上买些什么。
questions.explanation: 封底明确说明是“thousands of years ago（几千年前）”以及“what people bought and sold（过去人们买卖什么）”，并非现代（today）。

questions.prompt: You may find this book in the "History Books" part of the library.
questions.translation: 你可以在图书馆的“历史类书籍”区域找到这本书。
questions.explanation: 《古代丝绸之路》属于历史题材书籍，通常归类在图书馆的历史书架。

sections.title: 十二、读新闻报道，选择正确选项
sections.instruction: 读新闻报道，根据报道内容选择正确选项，将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
Choo choo! The world's first steam(蒸汽) train ran in the UK in 1825. It went 24 kilometers an hour. Whoosh! Today, China's CR450 high-speed train surprises the world. It runs up to 450 kilometers an hour in tests. This makes it the world's fastest high-speed train.

How can a train run so fast? It must be "thin and strong", said Chen Can, an engineer (工程师) of the train.

To help the train "lose weight", scientists build the train with special materials(材料), such as carbon fiber(碳纤维). The materials are strong and light. This cuts the train's weight by 10%. Also, engineers give the train's nose a cool new look. Now, CR450's nose is thin and long, just like an arrow(箭头). This way, the train runs through the air more easily.

Over the past 200 years, trains have become faster and faster. Will there be an even faster train one day? Anything is possible(可能的)。

questions.prompt: How fast did the world's first steam train go?
questions.translation: 世界上第一列蒸汽火车速度有多快？
questions.explanation: 第一段提到“The world's first steam train ran in the UK in 1825. It went 24 kilometers an hour.”。

questions.prompt: Who is Chen Can?
questions.translation: 陈灿是谁？
questions.explanation: 第二段提到“said Chen Can, an engineer of the train”，说明他是列车工程师。

questions.prompt: Why do the scientists use special materials to build the train?
options: Because the materials are new and cool.
Because the materials are light and strong.
questions.translation: 科学家为什么使用特殊材料来制造列车？
questions.explanation: 第三段提到“The materials are strong and light. This cuts the train's weight by 10%.”。

questions.prompt: What does "This way" in Paragraph 3 refer to (指的是)?
options: Using an arrow to make the train's nose.
Making the train's nose thin and long.
Getting the train run through the air easily.
questions.translation: 文中第三段中的“This way”指的是什么？
questions.explanation: 紧接前句“Now, CR450's nose is thin and long, just like an arrow. This way...”，指通过将车头做成细长如箭的造型。

questions.prompt: What is the best title of the report?
options: How did the steam train work?
What makes the train so fast?
questions.translation: 这篇报道的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章核心阐述了中国CR450高铁列车如何通过轻量化材料和气动外形设计达到极高速度，最佳标题是“是什么让列车如此之快？”。

sections.title: 十三、阅读短文，按要求完成任务
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，完成短文后相应的任务。
sections.passage:
Food Travels Around the World

Food has a cool history! Many people think ice cream comes from America, but its earliest form(雏形) started in China. Long ago, Chinese people saved winter ice to stay cool in summer. Later, they made binglao, an old Chinese frozen dessert. One emperor(皇帝) ate too much and got a stomachache.

Then Marco Polo, a traveller from Italy, came to China. He tried binglao and loved it. He took the idea back to Europe (欧洲). People there put milk and new flavours into it. Soon, everyone around the world loved it!

Different places can have similar foods, too. Iranian(伊朗的) bread looks just like stone-baked flatbread from Shaanxi, China. And while some people call roujiamo the "Chinese hamburger," it really looks more like food from South America!

Food brings people together. When food travels far, fun things happen. So next time you eat ice cream, remember it started in China!

questions.prompt: What did Chinese people do with winter ice long ago?
options: They sold it to make money.
They saved it to stay cool in summer.
They used it only to make binglao for the emperor.
questions.translation: 很久以前中国人拿冬天的冰来做什么？
questions.explanation: 第一段提到“Long ago, Chinese people saved winter ice to stay cool in summer.”。

questions.prompt: In Europe, what did people do to binglao?
options: They took it back to China.
They put milk and new flavours into it.
questions.translation: 在欧洲，人们对冰酪做了什么改良？
questions.explanation: 第二段提到“People there put milk and new flavours into it.”。

questions.prompt: What does Iranian bread look like?
questions.translation: 伊朗的面包看起来像什么？
questions.explanation: 第三段提到“Iranian bread looks just like stone-baked flatbread from Shaanxi, China.”。

questions.prompt: The writer says, "When food travels far, fun things happen." What does the writer mean?
options: The food on trips is always tasty.
Food from other places can surprise us and help us learn.
questions.translation: 作者说“当美食走向远方，有趣的事情就会发生”，作者的意思是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章讲述食物在跨文化传播中碰撞出新的变化与相似性，带来惊喜与认知，对应选项 C。

questions.prompt: What does the writer want to tell us about food?
questions.answer: Food has a cool history and brings people together when it travels around the world.
questions.translation: 作者想通过这篇文章告诉我们关于食物的什么道理？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“Food brings people together. When food travels far, fun things happen.”及开头“Food has a cool history!”总结回答。
